ns2:section.sectionText: Unlock your potential in the dynamic world of cybersecurity with our Fundamentals of Information Security course based off the prestigious Certified Information Systems Security Professional cerfication. In an era where data security is paramount, this course empowers you with the knowledge and skills needed to become a cybersecurity expert. Dive deep into the realms of risk management, security architecture, the security of AI/ML systems, and cryptography. Using engaging, real-world case studies, this course not only equips you with the technical expertise but also positions you for tackling emerging cybersecurity issues as an information professional.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Not intended for students with Freshman class standing. Restricted to Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign.
